preconditions.description: k is a positive integer between 1 and 26 inclusive.
q is a non-empty string of lowercase Latin letters with length between 1 and 100 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'NO' if not any(len(set(s[0] for s in partition)) == len(partition) for partition in partitions(q, k)) else stdout.strip() == 'YES'
postconditions.description: If no partition of q into k non-empty substrings exists where all first characters are distinct, output 'NO'. Otherwise, output 'YES' followed by any valid partition.

postconditions.expression: all(len(s) >= 1 for s in [stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, k+1)]) if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the next k lines must be non-empty strings that concatenate to q.

postconditions.expression: len(set(s[0] for s in [stdout.splitlines()[i] for i in range(1, k+1)])) == k if stdout.strip() == 'YES' else True
postconditions.description: If 'YES' is printed, the first characters of the k strings must all be distinct.
